# JuniperGate reference

Fictional independent test reference.

JuniperGate.cancelRequest performs the supported operation. The cancellationId field selects its parameter. Cancellation stops pending work before the operation completes. JuniperGate uses this operation and field together. pending operation cancellation.

Use JuniperGate.cancelRequest with cancellationId; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
